rules.statement: The High Court Judge incorrectly granted an interim injunction in circumstances where the bank was not responsible for the non-renewal of the insurance policy.
rules.supporting_quote: The High Court Judge erred in granting an interim injunction in the particular circumstances of the case. Per Wijetunga, J. " . . . . . . . the learned High Court Judge could not possibly have placed the blame on the appellant Bank for the non-renewal of the insurance policy, consequent to which the 1st respondent was unable to obtain compensation from the insurers to repair the bus''

meta.parties: Hatton National Bank Limited v. Hithanarchchi and Another
